verdict.rationale:
Smithery exposes a full OpenAPI 3.1 spec (35 paths) and even serves its documentation itself as an MCP endpoint that agents can query interactively via JSON-RPC, which supports AI-native exploration of the API surface. However there's no evidence of a classic interactive reference UI (e.g., Swagger/Redoc 'try it out' runnable examples in-browser), and alternate machine-readable doc formats (llms.txt, docs.md) return 404s.
missing for 10: an actual interactive/try-it-out API console with executable example requests, evidence of runnable code snippets in docs, independent confirmation of usability of the MCP-served docs.
